description: Reviewed snapshot of the modeled pipeline's Stage 4 prepared water-surface polygon set for Creek Segment 27714637-026, the Creek Segment assigned to the Jalama Near Lompoc gauge (USGS 11120600). npm run pipeline:publish copies it unchanged into water-surface-polygon-sets.json, so observed and modeled water draw the same polygons. It holds only that Creek Segment's set, in the published file's shape.
extraction: Kept segmentNetworkVersion and the one waterSurfacePolygonSets entry whose segmentId is 27714637-026, unchanged, then wrote it as two-space-indented JSON with a trailing newline (the published file format).

elevationBuckets.layout: 129 contiguous 0.05 m buckets from the 0.05 m step at or below the Stage 1 bed (25.748 m), then 8 contiguous 0.25 m buckets to at least 2 m above the highest modeled WSE (32.107 m)
